title: A separated finite type scheme of dimension at most one admits an H-projective completion whose boundary is a finite set of closed points
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma completes a separated finite type scheme of dimension at most one over a field to an H-projective scheme with scheme theoretically dense image whose boundary is a finite set of closed points. The proof invokes the quasi-projectivity lemma to embed X as a locally closed subscheme of projective d-space, takes the scheme theoretic image Xbar of that map, and reads off H-projectivity and scheme theoretic density from the description of the closure of a quasi-compact immersion (proof lines 9246-9254). It then shows that the dimension of Xbar is one by comparing generic points, and uses Noetherianity to conclude that the complement is a finite set of closed points (proof lines 9255-9260). H2: the passage from quasi-projective to H-projective through the scheme theoretic image and the boundary count are the substance.
